title: C4OS Grill Question 009A - Workspace Chat Identity

questions.label: How should user-level chat sessions be associated with a loaded workspace file?
questions.help: Recommended: use a workspace identity derived from the workspace file path plus an optional generated workspace ID saved inside the workspace file. This lets renamed/copied files be handled intentionally while keeping sessions out of the workspace file.
options: Workspace file contains a generated workspace ID used to look up user-level chats
Workspace file path is the workspace identity
Workspace identity is derived from workspace name plus project folder list
Each project folder path owns its chats regardless of workspace file

questions.label: If two workspace files contain the same project folders, should they share chats?
questions.help: Recommended: no, each workspace file has its own relative chats unless the user explicitly duplicates/imports chat history.
options: No, each workspace file has separate relative chats
Yes, same project folders share chats across workspace files
Project chats are shared but unassigned workspace chats are separate

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify what should happen if a workspace file is renamed, copied, moved, or edited to add/remove project folders.
